title: "[S0-01] Set up the repository and development environment"
---

## Goal

Make sure every student can work locally and contribute to the shared GitHub repository.

## Tasks

- Each student clones the group repository and checks their GitHub access.
- Install Python 3.12 and uv, then run the setup commands shown below from the repository root.
- Each student creates a branch, adds their name to a shared Contributors section in `README.md`, commits the change, pushes the branch and opens a PR linked to this issue.
- Arrange peer review, resolve any conflicts without removing other names, merge the PRs and update each local checkout from `main`.
- Confirm that the PR base is your group repository, not the upstream starter.

```sh
uv sync --locked
uv run python -m gridworld.views.pygame_render
```

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All eight students can clone the repository, install the dependencies and open the supplied Pygame preview on their own machine.
- [ ] The preview closes with Escape or the window close button. This is a static preview; the playable game is delivered through the other issues.
- [ ] Each student has opened their own PR adding their name to `README.md`.
- [ ] All eight PRs have been reviewed and merged; all eight names appear once in the Contributors section.
- [ ] Each student has pulled the merged changes into their local checkout.

## Evidence

Add the eight PR links and a setup checklist with one entry per student to this issue. Each student confirms successful installation and preview launch. Close the issue once all eight entries are complete.

Use manual checks in S0. Automated tests begin in S1.
Organize the work and peer reviews within your group.
